phosphor-green.$description: Phosphor Green — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

mint-pulse.$description: Mint Pulse — Link text and inline accent — a slightly cooler green variant for textual references that shouldn't compete with primary CTAs

forest-depth.$description: Forest Depth — Hover and pressed borders on green CTAs — keeps the button identifiable when the fill darkens on interaction

midnight-emerald.$description: Midnight Emerald — Deepest green surface — for low-key brand-tinted backgrounds, subtle section washes, and disabled-brand states

snow.$description: Snow — Primary text, icon strokes, button labels — the dominant foreground across the entire interface

silver-mist.$description: Silver Mist — Secondary headings, nav items, body emphasis — readable but never competing with Snow

smoke.$description: Smoke — Tertiary text, captions, helper text, muted icon fills — the voice of metadata and annotations

graphite.$description: Graphite — Icon outlines, low-emphasis borders, divider lines, and stroke color for illustrative line work

slate.$description: Slate — Input borders, subtle dividers, hairline separators between nav and content

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Card and component borders — the most-used border color, giving surfaces their defined edge without a visible shadow

ash.$description: Ash — Elevated surface tier for nested cards, hover states, and popover backgrounds

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Page canvas — the deep near-black foundation behind every section and card

accent.$description: Accent for emphasis that is not a state. The brand blue. Meets 3:1 on every surface.

border.$description: Hairline border. Meets 3:1 on every surface except where documented as decorative.

syntax-string.$description: 코드 강조색을 별도 팔레트 대신 원본 색상으로 통일

syntax-function.$description: 코드 강조색을 별도 팔레트 대신 원본 색상으로 통일

syntax-number.$description: 코드 강조색을 별도 팔레트 대신 원본 색상으로 통일

color.$description: Colors. Primitive hues and grays hold hex values. Semantic tokens (everything outside the hue and gray groups) reference primitives only.

gray.$description: Neutral scale. The step is the darkness in thousandths: (255 - channel) / 255 * 1000, rounded. 0 is white and 1000 is black. Every step has R=G=B.

blue.$description: Brand blue (#125DE6) and its steps. Used for what is happening now, the main data series and controls. The anchor is the only hand-picked value. Every other step is computed from it by scripts/palette.mjs against the contrast rules.

purple.$description: Purple for rare emphasis. The anchor is the only hand-picked value. Every other step is computed from it by scripts/palette.mjs against the contrast rules.

red.$description: Red for errors. The anchor is the only hand-picked value. Every other step is computed from it by scripts/palette.mjs against the contrast rules.

green.$description: Green for normal and success states. The anchor is the only hand-picked value. Every other step is computed from it by scripts/palette.mjs against the contrast rules.

orange.$description: Orange for the comparison series and caution only. The anchor is the only hand-picked value. Every other step is computed from it by scripts/palette.mjs against the contrast rules.

fg.$description: Body text. Meets 4.5:1 on every surface.

muted.$description: Secondary text. Meets 4.5:1 on every surface.

group-title.$description: Title text of a grouped region. Meets 4.5:1 on the three depth surfaces.

bg.$description: Base surface (the board). Depth 0 of the neutral hierarchy.

group-1.$description: Surface of the first nesting depth. One step stronger than bg, fully neutral (R=G=B).

group-2.$description: Surface of the second nesting depth. One step stronger than group-1, fully neutral.

group-3.$description: Surface of the third and deeper nesting depths. Fully neutral.

node.$description: Surface of a shape or card placed on bg.

surface.$description: Quiet surface for omitted or secondary regions. Slightly off bg.

card.$description: Default card surface. Within a small OKLab distance of node.

card-on.$description: Card surface when active, tinted with the brand blue fill.

page.$description: Document page surface behind a board.

outline.$description: Outline of shapes. Meets 3:1 on bg, the depth surfaces, node and card.

plate-border.$description: Edge of the board against the page. Decorative, 1.3:1 or more.

active.$description: What is happening now: lit lines, dots and borders. The brand blue. Meets 3:1 on every surface.

active-fill.$description: Face of what is happening now. Meets 4.5:1 with on-active text.

active-text.$description: Text that points at what is happening now. Meets 4.5:1 on bg, node and page.

on-active.$description: Text on active-fill and on flow tone faces. Meets 4.5:1.

error.$description: Error or failure. Graphic use only, 3:1 on every surface.

success.$description: Success or normal. Graphic use only, 3:1 on every surface.

warning.$description: Warning or caution. The orange. Graphic use only, 3:1 on every surface.

glow.$description: Pale halo around what is lit.

brand.$description: First flow tone, the brand blue.

purple.$description: Flow tone for a rare accent.

gray.$description: Flow tone for the third and later flows.

control-on.$description: Face of a selected segmented control.

main.$description: Series the chart argues for (new, improved). The brand blue.

compare.$description: Baseline series (old). Orange is for comparison and caution only.

heat-low.$description: Low end of the heat scale.

heat-high.$description: High end of the heat scale. Meets 4.5:1 with heat-ink-on text.

heat-ink-on.$description: Light ink on dark heat cells.

grid.$description: Grid and axis lines. Decorative, 1.5:1 or more.

heading.$description: Circular 파일이 없어 현재 설치된 폰트를 사용하는 역할별 스택. 원본 Circular를 대체하지 않고 폴백에 유지
